name: 变戏法的
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:3787
who: Pepper Foldcard, an older version of this person: a halfling conjurer who has played the roads for fifty years, seventy-one in 649 and, being a hero of the highest rank, looking only a little past her prime for her folk. About 108 cm, small and light, still quick on her feet. Honey-gold curly hair tied in two bunches with a few strands of white through it, a small butterfly folded from a playing card pinned at the end of each bunch. A round face, a dusting of freckles across the bridge of the nose, very large bright teal-green eyes that miss nothing. No earrings, no glasses. Her short cape is red-and-white diamond check. A nimble, chattering, warm-hearted trickster air; the most afraid of pain of the six, and the best at making a crying child laugh.
face_extra: A few faint laugh lines at the corners of the eyes, nothing more; the face is still round and bright.
build: 108 cm, small and light, a small round frame.
palette: card red and white, honey gold with white strands, teal green, dark brown, a little black
casual: With the travelling troupe: a short red-and-white diamond-check cape fastened at the throat, a long-sleeved linen shirt, a dark brown waistcoat with many small pockets, braces over knee-length dark brown breeches, red-and-white striped knee stockings that leave no leg bare, soft laced shoes. Three decks of cards in small leather pouches at her belt. She fans a hand of cards in one hand with a quick closed-mouth grin.
private: Behind the wagon after a show: the cape off, a loose long-sleeved linen shirt, long brown wool trousers, a knitted waistcoat buttoned up, the two card butterflies still pinned in her hair. She stands squaring a deck in both hands, quiet for once.
battle: The night of the feast, in a conjurer's war kit tailored for her by the best hands: the red-and-white diamond-check cape woven through with fine silver ward-thread, its diamonds glowing faintly at the edges; under it a fitted brigandine of tiny enchanted plates covered in red-and-white diamond cloth, a thin teal rune line along each seam; slim steel bracers with brass hinges on both wrists, a lit teal crystal in each, playing cards slotted inside; the striped stockings and soft climbing shoes. A spray of glowing playing cards fans out from her right hand, a few spinning in the air and turning into paper butterflies; her left hand is held open and empty, palm out. Sharp bright eyes and a closed-mouth smirk.
formal: As the troupe's showwoman: a fitted red-and-white diamond-check doublet with a small white ruff and long sleeves ending in white lace cuffs, dark knee breeches over white stockings, buckled black shoes, a little black felt cap with one white feather. The card butterflies are freshly folded. She stands in a showman's bow, one hand on her chest, the other sweeping out wide.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large. Her teal-green eyes glance sideways at the viewer over a fan of cards held near her cheek, a sly closed-mouth smile, a strand of white in the honey-gold curls. Hot orange light from below and one side, cold iron-blue shadow on the other. Foreground blur: drifting playing cards, folded paper butterflies and links of a broken chain.
gear: 英雄（宴火六人，英雄里最高的一截）｜贫｜轻身，不披重甲｜4档｜649年她是英雄里最高的一截，英雄往上不看家境，照四档给量身做的战装；她要轻身上房、靠牌和障眼法，所以是一件裹着菱格布的细甲片软甲和两只插牌的护腕，不穿板甲，斗篷照旧。598年那一版是共鸣一档，跟着位阶往上走，偏好不变。
